title: SiMa Neat Model Registry dataset requirements
description: datasets/<id>.yaml, one file per Dataset Registry dataset: the name the model browser shows for it, and the accuracy metrics a model must report on it, by the model's task. A model with several tasks reports the metrics of each.

name.description: The dataset's name as its authors write it, such as "COCO 2017". The model browser shows it in place of the Dataset Registry ID.
